response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.order_count - k.avg_count AS above_overall_average, k.order_count - ka.avg_count AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC LIMIT 10;
